title: PolicyReply
description: The policy worker's answer to one PolicyQuery (ADR-010 §2): a Recommendation, or a refusal. unsupported_candidate (the worker's parser does not know a candidate's shape) is a harness incident, never a policy forfeit; invalid_query (the query broke a contract or reader rule) is a harness fault too. The client re-checks a Recommendation before use: its identity is the query's and its choice one of the query's candidates.

query_id.description: The query_id of the PolicyQuery this answers.

Recommendation.description: A policy's answer to one request (#678 §4.3). A consumer drops it unless its identity matches the current request (ADR-008 §4).

choice.description: One choice from the request's LegalChoiceSet, in canonical engine syntax.

source_policy_id.description: The policy that produced the choice; the fallback's ID when it fell back.

elapsed_ms.description: From receipt of the request to the choice being ready.

deadline_outcome.description: How the submitted choice came about (#678 §3).

RequestIdentity.description: Which request a decision answers (ADR-008 §4). A consumer drops a recommendation unless request_seq and request_hash both match, and rqid too when both carry one.

request_seq.description: Areneon's 1-based count of the requests one player has received in this battle, including wait requests.

request_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical request JSON without rqid (ADR-008 §4): lowercase hex.

rqid.description: The Showdown server's request id; present only on the server path (A2), never hashed.

detail.description: A short reason, never the query's content.
